description: This script handles uploading logs from a device, including TLS connection attempts, HTTP uploads, and S3 uploads, with retry logic and log management.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp to the DCM log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on error code.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a TLS connection to the SSR server using curl.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, with retries and S3 upload handling.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log upload process during device reboot, including tarball creation and cleanup.
